summary: Two groups of campaign staff hand off a draft across an overnight journey.
realLife: Charles Murphy recalled sending drafts out of Washington at night by courier plane so the train staff could work with Truman on the text before that evening's address.
inGame: needs: draft readiness and scheduled delivery.

turns.pulledBy: The draft reaches the traveling team before the workday.
turns.what: Aides review it with the candidate.
turns.writesBack: The evening speaker has time to revise it.

turns.pulledBy: The handoff misses the traveling party.
turns.what: The home office identifies the next available delivery.
turns.writesBack: The candidate starts from notes already available.
